security_concerns.summary: Existing-stage ownership is not checked before parent writes or Unity launch.
security_concerns.detail: For an existing regular stage with matching compiler pins, the launcher calls write_boundary and compares compiler membership, but neither checks .supplied-art-owned-stage.json. It then opens existing stage header targets with wb and launches Unity. validate_authorization also does not authenticate the stage marker. The native Admit checks the exact marker only inside the launched Editor, too late to protect the parent writes and initial Editor import. A missing or foreign marker therefore does not fail closed at the parent write/launch boundary. This does not demonstrate accepted-player writes; the affected target is the exact new stage.
security_concerns.evidence: independent-results.json: launcher missing marker reaches overwrite-capable stage_write; original existing-stage AST statements and stage_write helper executed only against a directly owned fixture, with actual recursive guard checks. The fixture had no stage marker and its pre-existing noncompiler header was overwritten. Operational main and Unity were not executed.
security_concerns.required_fix: Before any write or launch, require an existing stage's exact owned marker as well as its recursively validated closure. Refuse missing/foreign ownership; do not create or repair a marker to authorize an existing foreign stage. Add an isolated missing/wrong marker preservation regression.

logic_errors.summary: Launcher rejects the explicitly allowed existing-stage auto-import transition.
logic_errors.detail: Prepare receipts retain effectiveStagePins equal to sourcePins. validate_authorization intentionally allows separately validated new file/folder metadata with allow_pending=True. The launcher's next unconditional compiler_manifest(stage) != effectiveStagePins check rejects exactly those metadata extras. Thus the corrected Python/C# import transition works for a pristine first launch but cannot be used to admit an already auto-imported, otherwise approved prepare stage. The no-destructive-restage contract leaves that legitimate resume/retry blocked.
logic_errors.evidence: independent-results.json: original launcher existing-stage branch refused an added valid new A.cs.meta while actual verify_import_closure accepted the same fixture/frozen source/explicit allowance. Existing lifecycle tests independently demonstrate complete file/folder transition admission in C# and Python.
logic_errors.required_fix: For prepare actions, use the independently validated bounded import transition rather than unconditional source equality. Preserve original frozen source pins for attestation; do not silently rebase onto arbitrary actual extras or repin source changes. Keep exact effective disk closure equality for BuildWindows.

static_security_and_logic: Trusted canonical parent receipt hash is required; full source/tool/protected-state/art-binding validation precedes launcher writes. Native raw attestation SHA token must be supplied through one exact CLI argument and binds action/root/stage/candidate plus four payload hashes. Actual Unity CLI/API execution remains untested.
Recursive stage/candidate reparse checks precede explicit operations; candidate Saves entry is refused by name. Parent stage ownership ordering is the exception recorded as PARENT-01.

Metadata planner requires absent Root metadata, unchanged pinned asset bytes and unique GUIDs; folder allowance is fixed, not arbitrary. Native helpers author only new profiles and a separately named scene in stage. Parent launcher performs no Root adoption. Actual adoption remains a separate parent create-new/no-overwrite step.

Owner exception is authenticated by the trusted receipt digest and exact approval-file SHA; only the named Base PSD old/new hashes can differ. Historical pins remain verbatim; missing/default/untrusted/extra/other-file exceptions fail. Base runtime inputs and accepted players remain protected.

Driver pins expected manifest bytes before output creation and validates literal 126 canonical IDs, six wrapper roles, distinct paths, dimensions and pixel SHA schema. All 126 literal IDs were parsed from the complete source and matched against the real pinned manifest, not a truncated display.

Driver checks all native face and wrapper pixel hashes, actual six-pack/66-card history, count reconciliation, unique checks/captures, required named screenshots/checks, explicit integer zero build warnings/errors and stage/candidate pin equality before launch.

Probe is opt-in through exact bounded fixture/save/artifact paths and PID-bound handshake; exceptions become failed checks. It uses production transactions and borrowed texture references, not catalog/RNG/save behavior changes. RunAudio is unused and not counted as full playlist execution.

Driver normal exit requires actual process returncode zero. Timeout/nonzero paths cannot set normal success; terminate/kill includes waits. Validation failures propagate even after zero exit. Preservation finalizer compares before/after. These process paths were reviewed statically, not exercised with a player.

No operational write target resolves to any accepted player. Legacy preservation player manifests prune Saves/Logs by entry name before stat/reparse/traversal; independent real dangling-link fixtures verified that behavior.
